title: Muzzle Velocity
setup: Neon traces the signature to Muzzle's lab and is tempted by an invitation to see the technology properly.
escalation: Muzzle demonstrates that his muzzle is an authenticated human maintenance interface: it sends commands to compatible implants and connected machines through nearby relays. He briefly immobilizes a test drone and a consenting guard to prove it. He then tries to force Neon into a research agreement.
resolution: Neon and Ghost escape with the interface specification, using the known implant blocker within its limits. The crew learns the muzzle's remarkable function and its constraints: local relay reach, compatible hardware and an authentication credential. Muzzle remains dangerous but cannot control arbitrary unaugmented animals.
continuity: Pays off the Season 1 mystery. Keep the muzzle on his face; do not replace it with a magic power or generic mask. His visible eyes and dog anatomy remain essential.
comedy: The terrifying override procedure is interrupted by an expired research-software license.
ending_hook: The specification identifies a dormant human retrieval channel.
status: Development draft — not scripted or recorded
